package domain

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
)

type WorkspaceFile struct {
	Path     string `json:"path"`
	Content  string `json:"content"`
	ReadOnly bool   `json:"read_only,omitempty"`
}

type StarterBuildInput struct {
	MilestoneKind     string          `json:"milestone_kind"`
	StackCode         string          `json:"stack_code"`
	PartTypeCode      string          `json:"part_type_code"`
	LanguageCode      string          `json:"language_code"`
	PracticeTaskTheme string          `json:"practice_task_theme"`
	ConfigJSON        json.RawMessage `json:"config_json"`
	Difficulty        string          `json:"difficulty"`
}

type StarterBuildResult struct {
	Files         []WorkspaceFile `json:"files"`
	ReadOnlyFiles []string        `json:"readonly_files"`
	EditableFiles []string        `json:"editable_files"`
	Entrypoints   []string        `json:"entrypoints"`
	PreviewConfig map[string]any  `json:"preview_config"`
	Meta          map[string]any  `json:"meta"`
}

type StarterBuilder interface {
	Supports(kind string) bool
	BuildStarter(ctx context.Context, input StarterBuildInput) (StarterBuildResult, error)
}

type BuilderRegistry interface {
	GetStarter(kind string) (StarterBuilder, bool)
}
